get.description:
The size/price a teacher must be shown before checkout/export
confirmation -- see `app.services.pricing_service`. Recomputes fresh
on every call (also refreshing the cached `Paper.quoted_*` columns)
rather than trusting a stale cache, and never charges or consumes
anything.

Size, price and entitlement standing for this paper, recomputed
fresh. Call this before offering "Export" so the teacher always sees
the price *before* confirming -- never a surprise at payment time.

post.description:
Generate a final export of this paper.

Consumes one paper-export entitlement if the paper is billable (it
contains premium content) -- and only after the file has been
generated successfully, so a failed render never costs a credit.
Returns 402 with the paper's size and price when an entitlement is
required but unavailable.

Papers at or above `EXPORT_ASYNC_QUESTION_THRESHOLD` questions are
rendered in the background: the response comes back with
`status: "pending"` and no `download_url`; poll
`GET /api/v1/exports/{id}` until it is `completed`.

Generate a free, watermarked preview of this paper.

Never requires or consumes an entitlement -- a teacher must be able
to see exactly what they would be buying. The result is clearly
marked (`is_preview: true`) and carries a PREVIEW watermark in
addition to any watermark the template itself defines.

Dev/test-only simulation of a payment gateway webhook. Requires
the caller to own the purchase being confirmed (a real gateway
webhook has no such notion -- it authenticates the *provider*, not a
user -- but this mock endpoint is reached directly by a logged-in
teacher for testing, so ownership is the appropriate guard here).

Submit one batch (e.g. N uploaded images, or N selected
questions) as a single logical job. Resubmitting the same
`idempotency_key` returns the existing job rather than enqueuing a
duplicate batch.

Upload an image to be used as OCR input (e.g. a photographed
question). Returns a `FileAsset` id to reference from a subsequent
`POST /jobs` (`job_type` one of `ocr_printed`/`ocr_math`/
`ocr_handwritten`, item `{"file_asset_id": "<this id>"}`).

Upload a `.docx` question paper and extract its document style
into a reusable template. Consumes one template-extraction trial/
purchase entitlement only if extraction succeeds; a failed
extraction (`status: "failed"`) costs nothing and can be retried.

delete.description:
Soft-delete: archives the template rather than physically
removing it (see `app.models.templates` module docstring) -- the
extracted structure/source file are never destroyed by this call.

post.description:
Re-extract from a new upload for an existing template, creating a
new version linked to it rather than overwriting it.

patch.description:
Activate or deactivate a user. Deactivating immediately revokes
every active session (see `app.services.admin.users.set_user_active`).
An admin cannot deactivate their own account through this endpoint.

Covers both feature definitions and trial configuration

get.description:
Cost/token totals grouped by provider and operation -- the
concrete "how much is OCR/AI usage costing us" view.

BackgroundJobItemStatus.title: BackgroundJobItemStatus
BackgroundJobItemStatus.description:
Per-item status within a batch job. Deliberately smaller than the
job-level status: an individual item is never itself "partially"
anything, and only a job (not a single item) can be cancelled before
it starts -- but an item that was queued and not yet attempted when
its job was cancelled is marked `CANCELLED` too, so "what happened to
item #7" always has an answer.

BackgroundJobStatus.title: BackgroundJobStatus
BackgroundJobStatus.description:
Overall status of a batch job. `PARTIALLY_SUCCEEDED` covers the
"20 images in, 17 OCR'd cleanly, 3 permanently failed" case: the
batch is done, but not every item succeeded, and the caller must be
able to tell the difference from a full success or a full failure.

job_type.title: Job Type
job_type.description: One of the supported operation types, e.g. 'ocr_printed', 'ocr_math', 'ocr_handwritten', 'ai_question_modification'.

items.title: Items
items.description: One entry per unit of work in the batch (e.g. one per uploaded image, or one per selected question).

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Client-supplied key; resubmitting the same key returns the same job.

format.description: PDF is the primary export format; DOCX is editable.

template_id.title: Template Id
template_id.description: A ready template of the current user's. Omit to use Qtor's default layout.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key. Resubmitting the same key returns the same export and never charges twice.

ExportReadinessOut.title: ExportReadinessOut
ExportReadinessOut.description:
Everything needed to render "Paper size: Medium — 18 MCQ · 2 CQ —
৳35 to export" before the teacher confirms.

download_url.title: Download Url
download_url.description: Relative API path to download the file once completed.

FeatureUpdateRequest.title: FeatureUpdateRequest
FeatureUpdateRequest.description:
Covers both feature definitions (name/description/is_active) and
trial configuration (trial_enabled) -- see `Feature.trial_enabled`.

MockPaymentWebhookRequest.title: MockPaymentWebhookRequest
MockPaymentWebhookRequest.description:
Simulates a payment gateway's callback. Dev/test only -- disabled
outside `development`/`test` environments (see `app/api/v1/billing.py`).
Not a real integration: no gateway is chosen yet.

PaperQuoteOut.title: PaperQuoteOut
PaperQuoteOut.description:
Answers "what size/price will this paper be" -- must be shown to
the teacher before checkout/export confirmation, per product spec.

PreviewCreateRequest.title: PreviewCreateRequest
PreviewCreateRequest.description:
Previews need no idempotency key: they are keyed server-side by a
deterministic fingerprint of the paper, template version and options,
so previewing an unchanged paper reuses the existing artifact.

PricingCatalogOut.title: PricingCatalogOut
PricingCatalogOut.description:
Everything a frontend needs to render pricing/plan pickers and
"what will this cost" copy, without hardcoding any of it client-side.

PricingRuleUpdateRequest.title: PricingRuleUpdateRequest
PricingRuleUpdateRequest.description: `code` is not editable -- see module docstring.

QuestionDetailOut.title: QuestionDetailOut
QuestionDetailOut.description:
Full representation for a single question, including options and
sources, for a question-detail view.

QuestionListItemOut.title: QuestionListItemOut
QuestionListItemOut.description:
Lean representation for search/list results -- no options/sources,
to keep list responses small at page sizes up to 100.

institution_name.title: Institution Name
institution_name.description: Replaces the text of the template's detected institution-name region. Omit to reproduce the template's own text verbatim.

metadata_lines.title: Metadata Lines
metadata_lines.description: Replaces the template's detected metadata lines (e.g. 'Subject: Physics   Time: 2 hours   Full Marks: 100'). Omit to reproduce the template's own lines.

reproduce_template_preamble.title: Reproduce Template Preamble
reproduce_template_preamble.description: Reproduce the template's own body content that precedes the questions area (titles, metadata, instructions). Disable to render only Qtor-supplied heading content.

include_answer_key.title: Include Answer Key
include_answer_key.description: Append a separate answer-key page. Only fills in answers that already exist in the paper's content; never generates them.

page_numbers.title: Page Numbers
page_numbers.description: Add a page-number field to the footer. Off by default so a reproduced template footer is never altered.

base_document.title: Base Document
base_document.description: 'auto' (recommended) starts from the teacher's original uploaded .docx for maximum fidelity, falling back to the extracted structure if that file is unavailable. 'structure' forces the structure-only path.

strict_missing_assets.title: Strict Missing Assets
strict_missing_assets.description: Fail the export if a referenced image is missing, rather than silently producing a paper with a figure omitted.

ReorderQuestionsRequest.title: ReorderQuestionsRequest
ReorderQuestionsRequest.description:
The full, exact set of this paper's paper-question IDs, in the
desired new order. Chosen over a single-item "move to position N"
operation because it maps directly onto how drag-and-drop reordering
UIs report changes, and avoids ambiguous index-shifting semantics.

TaxonomyLabels.title: TaxonomyLabels
TaxonomyLabels.description:
Human-readable labels resolved alongside a question, so the
frontend never has to make a second round trip (or ship its own
ID -> name maps) just to render a result row/card.

app__schemas__admin__PaymentOut.title: PaymentOut
app__schemas__admin__PaymentOut.description:
Deliberately omits `raw_payload` -- the provider's raw webhook/
response payload is not surfaced through the admin API; see
`app.services.admin.billing`'s module docstring.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Null means no weight has been configured for this type yet; quoting falls back to pricing_service's conservative default until one is set.
